truth_boundary: This registry defines candidate gaps for autonomous evidence review. It does not prove gap reduction until evidence receipts are generated and preserved.

active_gaps.current_state: OCODE syntax and examples exist, but no fully verified parser-renderer-evidence loop is proven in this repository.
active_gaps.desired_state: One .ocode page parses, renders in browser, supports interaction, produces evidence receipt, and records test result.
active_gaps.why_it_matters: OCODE must prove one bounded runtime loop before it can be treated as more than a language concept.
active_gaps.next_smallest_action: Create the first Daily Gap Governor evidence receipt and preserve it in GitHub.
